Separate logical authenticated context from transport dispatch epoch: logical state resets only for a genuinely different authority context/incarnation, while epoch advances on every transport binding/replacement including identical configuration.
Bind transport callbacks with their captured epoch. Already copied old callbacks return before config reads or sends.
Connect, Disconnect, SendHello, client sends, resends and resync capture epoch/transport/config and recheck after every synchronous callback.
A reentrant old hello sends old credentials to neither old nor replacement transport.
Schema failure stops after a context-changing frame-rejected listener; no old-context wire-error sibling runs.
Intent issuance reserves but does not advance the counter. Matching accepted/rejected/duplicate receipt advances it.
intent-identity abandons the in-flight intent, invalidates identity, disables submission and requires a fresh welcome; the new authoritative counter can then be reused without a gap loop.
A changed grant/incarnation discards old in-flight work; the same grant preserves an identical retry.
